observations: Photo 0 shows a white Xbox console with a black controller on top, placed on a wooden surface. The console has a silver perforated front panel and the Xbox logo visible on the top right.

Photo 1 shows a close-up of the same console from the side, with the controller resting on it. The console has a black front bezel and a silver perforated side panel. The Xbox logo is visible on the front.

Photo 2 shows a close-up of the side of the console, highlighting the silver perforated texture and the Xbox logo near the bottom. The console is placed on a wooden surface with a marble-patterned edge.
The console appears to be a standard Xbox One S model, identifiable by its size, shape, and perforated front panel.
The controller is black with standard Xbox buttons (A, B, X, Y) and analog sticks, consistent with a standard Xbox One controller.
No games or discs are visible in any photo.
No power cord, HDMI cable, or other accessories are shown.
The console shows some minor scuffs and wear on the white top surface, but no major damage is visible.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.
Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a black wireless controller resting on the console.
No screen or interface is shown to confirm installed games. The photos do not show the console's interface or any game discs.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not be 1TB as claimed
risks.proof: Photo of the console's system settings screen showing storage capacity, or a photo of the console's label with model and storage details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a lower-capacity model (e.g., 500GB) or as unverified capacity, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional or may have hardware issues
risks.proof: Video clip showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or menu.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: Games are not installed or are not functional
risks.proof: Photo or video of the console's home screen showing installed games, or a video of a game being played.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as no games included, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Controller may be non-functional or have battery issues
risks.proof: Video clip showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as controller not working, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Photo or video of the console's system settings showing storage capacity.
Photo or video of the console's home screen showing installed games.
Video of the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.
Photo of the console's label or model number label.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
